quick_skim.title: ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints
quick_skim.abstract: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Addresses partial point cloud completion by enforcing geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction with explicit projection and adaptive feature routing, a cross-modal imputation approach for sparse observations.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 点云补全因局部观测稀疏且歧义而困难。该文提出ProjFormer，通过显式投影的引导视图注意力对齐3D点与多视图像特征，再利用几何感知路由网络自适应融合结构特征与2D语义，完成缺失区域的点云生成。实验表明该方法在点云补全精度和几何一致性上优于现有方法，展示跨模态语义约束在缺失数据填补中的潜力。
